how: Aerokart in Argenteuil (about 20 minutes from Paris) runs a free-fall wind-tunnel simulator alongside its indoor karting and escape game.
The Cergy-Pontoise leisure island has an artificial whitewater river with waterfalls, obstacles and adjustable current for guided rafting, on reservation; natural-river rafting is far away.
venue: Ile de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise (stade d'eau vive)

how: Accrobranche at the Cergy-Pontoise leisure island has 12 aerial courses of rope bridges, nets and ziplines over the lakes, for ages 6 and up (shorter courses) and 1.50 m and up (harder ones).
Every course at the Cergy-Pontoise accrobranche includes ziplines, some over 200 m above the lake with speeds above 50 km/h.
The Cergy-Pontoise leisure island has an 820 m cable tow (teleski nautique) for water skiing and wakeboarding with obstacle modules, from about EUR 9.
venue: Ile de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise (teleski nautique)

how: The Cergy-Pontoise leisure island has an outdoor standing surf wave described as the largest in Europe, open to ages 8 and up.
venue: Ile de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise (vague a surf)

how: A 'Benji ejection' reverse bungee at the Cergy-Pontoise leisure island catapults riders to treetop height in under 2 seconds; no conventional bungee jump from a bridge or tower was found.
venue: Ile de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise (Benji ejection)
